# Vendored file

`B2-PROOF.md` is a byte-identical copy of
`research/ordinary-b2-bootstrap/PROOF.md` from
[PR #4338](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4338) at head
`0ac8192bdf6b5217787ffe44c4b1d91732ef6b23` (Git blob
`b723a2fdcad2753163959bac051424674650dd87`).

It is copied, not pinned, because that PR head is not reachable from canonical main.
`verify.py` checks its SHA256 before reading any phrase.

It was prepared for Ross Richardson with OpenAI Codex assistance and is Apache-2.0,
as its package states.
